End-to-End Enterprise Scenario: Autonomous Procure-to-Pay & Discrepancy Resolution

Stage 1: Enterprise Trigger & Event
• Analyze business event and initiate response.
• Validate trigger and data accuracy.

Stage 2: 3-Way Match & Risk Assessment
• Identify discrepancies in purchase order, receipt,
and invoice. Risk scoring and exception handling.

Stage 3: Auto-Resolution & Decision
• Automated negotiation and resolution based on
rules and historic data. Execute corrective actions.

Stage 4: Exception & Discrepancy Case
• Detailed discrepancy case for manual review
when necessary. Record action taken.

Stage 5: Process Loop & Optimization
• Loop for process improvement. Track performance
metrics. Define process improvement steps.
